description.value: A full-service restaurant and brewpub situated in View Royal along the Island Highway, housed in what the domain name 'fourmilehouse' suggests is a historic roadhouse building. The on-site brewery produces a rotating lineup of year-round and seasonal beers — from a light lager and West Coast IPA to a non-alcoholic option — all available on draft in the pub. The venue also includes the '4 Below' sports bar, a High Tea program, and weekend brunch, making it an unusually varied stop for cyclists passing through the western edge of Greater Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 25m; rack (5 spaces) at 27m; stands (4 spaces) at 60m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and consistently identifies the business as '4 Mile Restaurant & Brewpub' at 199 Island Hwy, Victoria BC V9B 1G1, phone (250) 479-2514 — different from the OSM name 'Four Mile Pub'. The site confirms online ordering (takeout), an in-house brewery, a sports bar, and a full food menu, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refills, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities. The business is clearly open and operating.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this as 'Four Mile Pub' but the website consistently uses '4 Mile Restaurant & Brewpub' across all pages. OSM name should be updated.
OSM record has no address, phone, or OSM tags populated — all contact details sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible brewpub and restaurant on the Island Highway in View Royal — a logical stop for cyclists on the Vancouver Crossing Loop route.

wow_evidence: historic roadhouse building ... on-site brewery produces a rotating lineup
